Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: game terrain-generation proposal illustration, a single landscape image.
Style: polished readable low-poly 3D real-time strategy game terrain concept. Elevated near-top-down oblique view of a complete square map, high enough to understand strategic geography but enough angle to clearly see elevation. Soft neutral daylight, no cinematic haze, no UI, no text, no border, no watermark.
Terrain: structural small square cells with coherent flat irregular plains, discreet stepped elevation bands, selective broad ramps, sparse steep rocky cliffs with narrow bevels and compact peaks. Preserve natural irregular landforms; avoid giant rectangular platforms, ledge carpets, floating stacked islands and smooth rolling heightfields. Terrain occupies the frame.
Show four spacious comparable opening clearings distributed around the map, tiny industrial headquarters for scale, connected routes where the layout requires. Large irregular salvage regions made of many small rusty scrap piles and scattered medium wrecks, sparse oil extraction pockets, distinguishable from rocks; clustered scenery with clear movement and construction space. Resource appearance illustrative, not numeric economic allocation.
Primary layout: OPEN PLAINS / ARID. Entirely dry broad tan/ochre ground, low gentle stepped hills, scattered compact rocky outcrops, sparse dry vegetation. Dominant connected usable flat ground. No water anywhere, no coast, no empty river channels or ocean-shaped shoreline. Four openings connected by several wide dry routes.
